critique.evidence: The “Your turn, Red.” framing, red/cyan adversarial palette, synthetic-attack sliders, and side-by-side Legacy Rules versus Intent Integrity verdict create a coherent red-team control-room identity across viewports. However, the main composition remains a familiar dark dashboard: bordered card, form controls, KPI bars, badges, and text findings. It is polished but lacks one unmistakable visual mechanism or signature artifact that would make the demo instantly recognizable.
critique.fix: Turn the same-event comparison into the signature visual: show the synthetic attack traveling from the red controls through five fused evidence layers into two diverging policy verdicts, with a clear animated or diagrammatic red-to-cyan causal path. Reduce generic card and progress-bar styling so this event-to-decision transformation dominates the screen.
